description: Feature 1: Coordinator PDF Upload for Coding Problems - adds parseCodingPdfText parser, POST /coordinator/coding/upload-pdf route, and the upload UI panel in coordinator-dashboard.html
steps: STEP 1 - Add parseCodingPdfText(rawText) function in server.js. Insert it AFTER the existing parsePdfQuestionText function (around line 3110, before handlePdfUpload). The parser must: split text on /PROBLEM\s+\d+\s*[.:]/i markers; for each block extract Title (required), Difficulty (optional, default 'Easy'), Description (required), Input Format, Output Format, Sample Input, Sample Output fields; then parse Test Cases section with lines like 'TC1:' or 'TC1 [Hidden]:' followed by 'Input: ...' and 'Output: ...' lines; [Hidden] means isHidden:true; multi-line inputs use | as separator (replace with newline); stop collecting a field value when the next known label (Title, Difficulty, Description, Input Format, Output Format, Sample Input, Sample Output, Test Cases) is encountered. Return array of objects: {title, difficulty, description, inputFormat, outputFormat, sampleInput, sampleOutput, testCases:[{input, expectedOutput, isHidden}]}

STEP 2 - Add route POST /coordinator/coding/upload-pdf in server.js. Insert it right after the existing app.post('/coordinator/test/upload-pdf-alt'...) line (around line 3170). Use upload.single('pdfFile') multer middleware. Follow the EXACT same try/catch/finally pattern as handlePdfUpload: read file to buffer, call getPdfParse()(buf, {version:'v1.10.100'}) with pdftotext CLI fallback, pass extracted text to parseCodingPdfText(rawText), return {success:true, count:N, problems:[...]} or {success:false, message:...}. Always delete temp file in finally block.

STEP 3 - In public/coordinator-dashboard.html, add the 'Upload Coding Problems via PDF' panel ABOVE the existing 'Add Coding Problem' section (insert before the div.test-section that starts at line 590). The panel includes: a test-section div with section-header icon and title, a file input for PDF, a 'Parse PDF' button, a format guide toggle (details/summary element), a status span, a preview container (div#codingPdfPreview) that shows parsed problem cards with title/difficulty/description/testCase count, and an Import All button that POSTs each selected problem to /coordinator/coding-questions with the domain from domainStr. Use the existing _esc() function for HTML escaping. Style using existing dark-theme CSS variables (--border, --bg-card, --muted, --text, var(--accent) etc.).

STEP 4 - Add the JavaScript functions for the coding PDF upload panel: parseCodingPdf() fetches POST /coordinator/coding/upload-pdf with FormData, displays status and renders preview cards; importCodingPdfProblems() loops through checked problems and POSTs each to /coordinator/coding-questions with domain:domainStr; resetCodingPdfUpload() clears the UI. Place these functions in the existing <script> block in coordinator-dashboard.html, near the other coding-related functions (around line 1739+).
acceptance_criteria: parseCodingPdfText correctly parses multi-problem PDF text with all fields and test cases including hidden markers
POST /coordinator/coding/upload-pdf returns {success:true, count, problems} for valid PDF
The coordinator dashboard coding tab shows the PDF upload panel above the manual form
Parse button triggers extraction, preview shows problem cards, Import button POSTs each to existing route
node --check server.js passes with no syntax errors
Existing routes and functionality are completely unchanged
